title: About Severe Sky Under Bass Pressure
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 262 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @lovidlovid: NY media art scene is so big and has such strong roots you really can’t grasp it... and @rachcorrine: Discussion we had this evening. In NYC we are bringing back the IRISH HELLO. AKA..., plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Severe Sky Under Bass Pressure: A minimal media-art threshold: architectural section, low-angle concrete-sky plate grammar. One hero-scale charcoal slab cuts diagonally from upper left toward the right edge, crushing a broad washed-blue sky field beneath it. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against oversized diagonal pressure beam, upper weathered concrete slab, and pale sky dropout aperture.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
